whyNotFixNow: 59,625 color warnings cannot be fixed in one session without risking UI regressions. 357 phase-scope FAILs require API binding work, not UI work. Fixing in one batch violates the phase-aware progression model. The baseline enables forward motion for the junior developer without allowing regression.
